title: Missing COAs and Batch Mismatches: Exception Handling for Nutrition Brand Agents
summary: How a nutrition document Genie stops on a missing COA, a partial lot code or a draft file, records both candidates, and asks quality for the approved one.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Design a nutrition document agent to stop when a COA is missing, the lot does not match, or approval and sharing status are unclear. Preserve the verified part of the request and send a precise question to the document owner. Similar filenames, product names, or dates cannot establish that a document covers the requested batch.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
